name: NVision Imaging Technologies
description: NVision Imaging Technologies develops quantum-based molecular technologies with two platforms: POLARIS, which uses quantum polarisation to enhance MRI signals by 10,000x for cancer metabolism imaging; and PIQC, a quantum computing platform based on molecular qubits native to photonic chips. Founded as a spinout of Ulm University, NVision has research collaborations with Cambridge, TU Munich, and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center.

products.name: POLARIS
products.description: Quantum polarisation platform that enhances MRI contrast agents by 10,000x for real-time cancer metabolism imaging in clinical trials

products.name: PIQC
products.description: Quantum computing platform based on molecular qubits integrated into photonic chips, targeting pharmaceutical discovery applications

highlights: Raised USD 55M Series B in May 2026 anchored by Abbott, expanding from quantum MRI sensing into molecular quantum computing
POLARIS platform deployed in clinical trials at leading cancer centres including Memorial Sloan Kettering
Expanded into UK with Cambridge hub opening and Aarhus University Denmark partnership in March 2026

news.title: NVision raises USD 55M Series B and expands into quantum computing with PIQC photonic platform
news.excerpt: NVision Imaging Technologies announced a USD 55M Series B anchored by Abbott, bringing total funding above USD 85M. Simultaneously the company launched PIQC, a molecular-qubit photonic quantum computing platform, expanding beyond its established POLARIS quantum MRI contrast enhancement technology. New Cambridge UK hub and Aarhus Denmark partnership announced in the same month.
